task: Find all small molecules mentioned in PubMed for which fraction absorbed, intestinal absorption, human intestinal absorption, effective intestinal permeability, Caco-2/MDCK/PAMPA permeability, aqueous/biorelevant solubility, dissolution, or GI stability has been experimentally reported as relevant to oral absorption.
task_instantiation:
Extract experimentally reported oral-absorption-relevant physicochemical or biopharmaceutic measurements for small molecules or small-molecule classes. In scope endpoints are: fraction absorbed or fraction dissolved after oral/GI administration; intestinal/human intestinal absorption rate/extent; intestinal effective permeability (P_eff or regional permeability); Caco-2, MDCK, or PAMPA apparent permeability/transport measures including efflux ratio when presented as an absorption/permeability assay; aqueous, buffer, simulated gastric/intestinal fluid, FaSSIF/FeSSIF, or other biorelevant solubility; dissolution rate/extent; and gastric/intestinal (GI) stability/degradation relevant to oral absorption. Create one record for each molecule/class × endpoint value/qualitative result × distinct experimental condition (e.g., different pH, medium, intestinal region, formulation, polymorph/salt, species, or assay system). If a passage reports multiple in-scope endpoints for the same molecule (e.g., solubility and fraction absorbed), create separate records unless one endpoint is only background context for the other; mention contextual values in `extra_details` if not making a separate record.

Only create records for experimentally measured, observed, or empirically estimated values/claims, including values read from tables or figures. Skip purely in silico/QSAR predictions, calculated descriptors not directly measuring an in-scope endpoint (e.g., cLogP, pKa, dose number alone), pharmacokinetics not specifically tied to oral/GI absorption (AUC, Cmax, Tmax, bioavailability alone), parenteral/buccal/sublingual/rectal data unless directly used as a comparator for GI/oral absorption, and formulation performance claims without an in-scope measured solubility/dissolution/permeability/stability/absorption endpoint. Qualitative experimental claims such as “highly permeable,” “poorly soluble,” or “stable in simulated gastric fluid” are in scope; do not infer labels from numeric values unless the authors state the label.

Use the paper’s entity list to set the top-level `global_identifier` for the molecule or class; do not put identifiers in the extracted object. Default context is standard physiological/oral absorption conditions and routine experimental conditions for the named assay. Put abnormal or interpretation-changing conditions in `qualifying_conditions` (e.g., disease model, transporter inhibitor, permeation enhancer, surgically altered gut, unusual co-administered albumin/sink agent, non-oral regional dosing used to infer regional absorption). Routine details such as species, intestinal segment, pH, medium, temperature, formulation, salt/polymorph, and assay system belong in their dedicated fields or `extra_details`, not in `qualifying_conditions` unless they are exceptional.

schema_spec.name: endpoint_category
schema_spec.description: Type of oral-absorption-relevant endpoint measured or stated.

schema_spec.name: assay_system
schema_spec.description: Experimental assay, model, or setting (e.g., Caco-2, MDCK, PAMPA, human jejunal perfusion, rat in situ perfusion, FaSSIF solubility, SGF dissolution, simulated gastric fluid stability).

schema_spec.name: reported_value
schema_spec.description: Reported numeric value, range, inequality, fold-change, or qualitative result exactly enough to preserve modifiers (e.g., '7.8 × 10^-6', '>90%', 'four times higher', 'stable', 'poorly soluble'). Use null if no explicit result value/claim is stated.

schema_spec.name: reported_units
schema_spec.description: Units for `reported_value` when applicable (e.g., cm/s, mg/mL, µg/mL, %, h^-1, mL/mg^(2/3)/h). Null for unitless qualitative results or ratios.

schema_spec.name: condition_medium
schema_spec.description: Medium, fluid, pH, buffer, or other chemical environment for the measurement (e.g., pH 6.5 FaSSIF, 0.1 M HCl, SGF, FeSSIF).

schema_spec.name: biological_context
schema_spec.description: Species, cell line, tissue, intestinal/GI region, or subject context (e.g., human jejunum, rat proximal intestine, cynomolgus monkey colon, Caco-2 monolayer).

schema_spec.name: formulation_or_solid_form
schema_spec.description: Formulation, dose form, salt, polymorph, particle form, or oral/regional delivery form if stated and relevant to the endpoint.

schema_spec.name: qualifying_conditions
schema_spec.description: Non-standard conditions that materially qualify interpretation (e.g., transporter inhibitor, permeation enhancer, disease/knockout model, co-administered BSA/sink condition, intracolonic dosing used to infer absorption). Null for standard or unspecified conditions.

schema_spec.name: extra_details
schema_spec.description: Free-form string for additional details that do not fit other top-level fields.
